title: Pairing with Claude on game systems and code drawn art
author: mendlogames
selftext:
Just shipped a free update to my idle farm game, Miners, Moos and Miracles: a new resource called Hope and four abilities you spend it on. Wanted to talk about how AI fit into building it rather than just drop patch notes.

I pair program the whole codebase with Claude. Not for art generation, the game deliberately loads zero image files, everything is drawn in code at runtime, but for the systems work. For this update that meant designing the Hope accrual curve and Miracle costs together, and extending an existing achievement pipeline so the new tiers matched sixty already shipped ones exactly.

Demo: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5082310/Miners\_Moos\_\_Miracles\_Demo/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5082310/Miners_Moos__Miracles_Demo/)
